identification: Set of 4 Edwardian carved parlour chairs, stained oak or similar, with carved crest rails, red patterned velvet padded back panels with braid trim, turned spindle galleries, turned front legs with brass castors and turned stretchers. Seat upholstery is a red, gold and green tapestry or Berlin-work-style woven pattern on three chairs; the rear-left chair appears to have a plain red velvet seat. The rear-left chair also has a different pierced scroll crest rail from the other three, so the set is slightly mismatched. Description says AS IS. Seat fabric looks worn.
